newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares weak ahead of TELCO results.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares weak ahead of TELCO results.

text.p: Delhi shares reversed trend to quote lower in afternoon trade on Tuesday as speculators restricted buying ahead of the announcement of truck maker TELCO's 1996/97 results, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index was down 0.52 point at 764.00 at 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT). It was 1.92 points up in early trade.
"Marketmen are waiting for the working results of TELCO, to be announced later in the day," said Harjit Singh of brokers Wadhwa Associates.
Analysts said on Monday that TELCO's net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) could surge some 35 percent compared to that in 1995/96.
State Bank of India shed 0.30 rupee to 304.30.
